title: Mahershala Ali confirms end of Blade and thanks Marvel
seoTitle: Mahershala Ali confirms end of Blade and thanks Marvel
subtitle: Actor says the project is over for him and reveals Marvel‑funded training was used in another film
excerpt: Mahershala Ali confirmed the Blade reboot was cancelled for his career, thanked Marvel for funding his combat training and said the skills were reused in a different.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Mahershala Ali publicly confirmed that his involvement in the Blade reboot has been terminated. The actor stated that the project "is over for me" and revealed that the combat training paid for by Marvel was repurposed for another production.

Statement at the Toronto Festival

During the Toronto Film Festival, Mahershala Ali gave an interview to Deadline and was emphatic about the end of his participation in the Marvel film. He said he will not play the character and is focused on other projects. "It's over for me. I'm doing this here and anything else from now on, so that's it, it's done. It's over for me," the actor declared.

The comment came while Ali was promoting the film "Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother," in which he stars alongside director Bassam Tariq. The production is part of the festival lineup and served as the backdrop for the revelations about the future of the vampire hunter.

Reuse of the training

Ali revealed that he trained for a year to portray Blade. That preparation period, which included learning hand‑to‑hand combat and swordplay, was financed by Marvel Studios. The actor explained that without that contribution he wouldn't have been able to make his new film.

"They helped pay for our film, so thank you. Really, we wouldn't have had the money for it. We couldn't have made this film. And I was able to train for a year. So right now I'm very grateful that they made such a wonderful contribution to our film," said Ali. Director Bassam Tariq added that the training may have lasted longer than a year.

Context of the cancelled project

The Blade reboot was initially announced at San Diego Comic‑Con 2019. Since then, the project faced numerous changes and, in 2024, the cancellation was confirmed. Mahershala Ali never got to star in the feature, limiting his involvement to a brief voice cameo in the post‑credits scene of the movie "Eternals."

With the actor's departure, the Blade film remains in development at Marvel Studios, with no set production or release date. Industry expectations are that the project could re‑emerge in the future, possibly with a new cast, sometime after 2028 as part of the post‑Multiverse Saga plans.

Mahershala Ali's new work

The film "Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother" explores complex themes such as faith, morality and violence. The production features Ali as a professional assassin who questions his convictions, moving away from the traditional hero figure. The narrative avoids glorifying violence, focusing on the character's internal dilemmas.

The film's approach divides opinions regarding its pacing, with occasional action scenes that aim to deepen the emotional conflict. The work marks an important moment in the actor's career, cementing his presence in dramas that challenge action‑genre conventions.

With information from Omelete, Tá Pipocando, O Vício.
